## Type 常用分类 - feat: 新功能、新特性 - fix: 缺陷修复:
## Common types
- feat: a new feature
- fix: a bug fix
- refactor: code change that neither adds a feature nor fixes a bug
- perf: a performance improvement
- docs: documentation changes
- style: formatting changes (whitespace, semicolons, layout) that do not affect behavior
- test: adding or adjusting tests
- chore: build process, tooling, or dependency changes

## Change list
- Use a bulleted list of "- " items to describe each change and refactoring detail (3 to 8 concrete items).
- Never use filler; record the changes objectively.
